name: view-modes-simple
description: Simple ladder for view modes: orbit ⇄ walk ⇄ 2D plan. Verify cameraMode toggles between orbit and firstPerson, 2D plan editor opens via setFloorPlanEditing, and mode-dependent UI (WalkHud for walk, catalog only in orbit) appears/disappears correctly. Simple-vs-Pro: walkthrough is simple-tier and must be ON.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-walkthrough-on-simple
steps.failMessage: walkthrough flag is OFF in Simple mode — expected ON (simple-tier)

steps.name: switch-to-walk-overlay-shown
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash never appeared, so the gone-wait below would pass vacuously. If this transition genuinely raises no splash (same mode, or the room editor owns the overlay) delete BOTH guard steps rather than widening the timeout.

steps.name: switch-to-walk-overlay-gone
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash still up; the next screenshot would capture the splash, not the scene. See docs/visual-verification-playbook.md.

steps.name: walk-mode-active
steps.failMessage: cameraMode did not switch to firstPerson

steps.name: verify-walk-hud-visible
steps.failMessage: WalkHud (.walk-hud) should appear in firstPerson mode

steps.name: back-to-orbit-overlay-shown
steps.failMessage: 'Switching to overview' splash never appeared, so the gone-wait below would pass vacuously. If this transition genuinely raises no splash (same mode, or the room editor owns the overlay) delete BOTH guard steps rather than widening the timeout.

steps.name: back-to-orbit-overlay-gone
steps.failMessage: 'Switching to overview' splash still up; the next screenshot would capture the splash, not the scene. See docs/visual-verification-playbook.md.

steps.name: plan-screen-visible
steps.failMessage: 2D plan editor (.plan-screen) did not mount after setFloorPlanEditing(true)
